title: Penetration Tester
description: Perform ethical hacking, exploit vulnerabilities, conduct simulated cyberattacks, and deliver actionable remediation reports to secure enterprise systems.

goal.objective: Safely emulate real-world cyberattacks against web apps, APIs, and enterprise networks to discover and patch security flaws before malicious hackers exploit them.

learn.summary: Master Burp Suite, Kali Linux tools, OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR), network enumeration (Nmap), Metasploit, privilege escalation, and executive reporting.
key_competencies: Web App Pentesting with Burp Suite Professional
prerequisites: Deep web architecture knowledge (HTTP, Cookies, Sessions)

capstone_projects.title: Full-Scope Active Directory Domain Escalation & Pivot Assessment
capstone_projects.description: Execute a full-scope internal network simulation compromising domain controllers through LLMNR poisoning, Kerberoasting, and ACL abuse in an isolated lab.

capstone_projects.title: Modern Web Application & API Penetration Testing Portfolio
capstone_projects.description: Perform comprehensive black-box and grey-box security assessments on a modern SPA and GraphQL API, identifying authorization bypasses and publishing CVSS reports.

interview_focus: OWASP Top 10 Vulnerabilities & Exploitation Mechanics (SSRF, SQLi, Insecure Deserialization)
Active Directory Attack Vectors (Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, Pass-the-Hash, Golden Ticket)
Bypassing Web Application Protections (WAF Evasion, CSRF Token Bypass, CORS Misconfigurations)
Privilege Escalation Techniques (Linux SUID/Capabilities, Windows Token Impersonation/Unquoted Service Paths)
Professional Pentest Reporting (CVSS 3.1 Scoring, Executive Summaries, Remediations)

tree.name: Foundational Cybersecurity & Pentesting Basics
tree.description: Establish an uncompromising penetration testing foundation: master network protocols, operating system internals, defensive evasion theory, legal rules of engagement, and attack laboratory infrastructure.

resources.title: Python for Everybody Specialization (Coursera/University of Michigan)
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Core Cybersecurity Concepts
children.description: Master foundational offensive security concepts: threat modeling, attack surfaces, vulnerability vs exploit vs payload, defense-in-depth, and evaluating security controls across network and application perimeters.

children.name: Networking & OS Internals
children.description: Deep dive into OS kernels and networking from an offensive perspective: TCP/IP packet construction (Scapy), raw sockets, Linux file permissions and capabilities, Windows access control lists (DACLs/SACLs), and process memory layouts.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Scripting & Automation for Security
children.description: Master offensive automation with Python and Bash: writing custom network scanners, automating credential stuffing, authoring multi-threaded web fuzzers, and writing custom exploit wrappers.

resources.title: Black Hat Python: Python Programming for Hackers and Pentesters

children.name: Web & API Technology Fundamentals
children.description: Understand web application architecture for exploitation: HTTP request/response state machines, session cookies, REST API conventions, GraphQL schema introspection, and WebSocket framing.

resources.title: How the Internet Works: A Practical Guide
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Ethical Hacking Methodologies & Ethics
children.description: Adhere to legal and professional standards: Rules of Engagement (RoE), scoping documents, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), and structured penetration testing methodologies (PTES, OWASP WSTG, NIST SP 800-115).

resources.title: NIST SP 800-115: Technical Guide to Information Security Testing and Assessment

children.name: Setting Up Your Hacking Lab & Basic Tools
children.description: Build a professional penetration testing laboratory: deploying vulnerable targets (Metasploitable, Active Directory labs, OWASP Juice Shop), configuring Kali Linux / Parrot OS, and isolating lab networks with host-only virtualization.

resources.title: Wireshark 101: Essential Skills for Network Analysis
Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

tree.name: Web Application Penetration Testing
tree.description: Master web application exploitation: intercepting proxies, advanced injection attacks, business logic flaws, and API vulnerability assessments.

children.name: OWASP Top 10 & Common Web Vulnerabilities
children.description: Master the OWASP Web Top 10 vulnerabilities from root cause to exploitation: Broken Access Control, Cryptographic Failures, Injection, Insecure Design, Security Misconfiguration, and Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Web Application Testing Proxies & Tools
children.description: Master Burp Suite Professional: traffic interception, Intruder custom payloads and pitchfork attacks, Repeater manual testing, Burp Collaborator for Out-of-Band Application Security Testing (OAST), and Turbo Intruder for race conditions.

resources.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy (Burp Suite Tutorials)

children.name: Advanced Injection Attacks (SQLi, Command, NoSQLi, LDAPi, XPathi)
children.description: Execute advanced injection attacks: boolean-based and time-based blind SQL injection, out-of-band SQLi, Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Jinja2/Twig achieving remote code execution (RCE), OS command injection, and LDAP injection.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Broken Authentication, Session Management & Access Control Bypass
children.description: Exploit authentication and session weaknesses: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR), multi-factor authentication (MFA) bypasses, session fixation, JWT tampering (algorithm confusion, signature exclusion, weak secret cracking), and OAuth 2.0 redirect URI hijacking.

children.name: Cross-Site Attacks (XSS, CSRF, Clickjacking)
children.description: Master client-side exploitation: Reflected, Stored, and DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), bypassing input filters, extracting session tokens, Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) via pre-authenticated requests, and Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH).

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) & Insecure Deserialization
children.description: Exploit server-side architecture flaws: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) bypassing private IP filters to query cloud instance metadata (IMDS), Insecure Deserialization in Java (`ysoserial`) and Python (`pickle`), and XML External Entity (XXE) data exfiltration.

children.name: REST, SOAP & GraphQL API Penetration Testing
children.description: Assess REST and GraphQL APIs: exploiting hidden endpoints, mass assignment vulnerabilities, GraphQL query depth bombs, and broken object property level authorizations.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Advanced Client-Side & Server-Side Web Attacks
children.description: Execute advanced protocol-level attacks: HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE and TE.CL desynchronization attacks), WebSocket hijacking, and Web Cache Poisoning.

resources.title: Web Security: A Guide to Hacking and Defense

children.name: Practical Project: Web Application Assessment
children.description: Web App Assessment Project: conduct a comprehensive penetration test of a multi-tier web application, document discovered injection and access control vulnerabilities, write weaponized PoCs, and submit a remediation report.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

tree.name: Network & Infrastructure Penetration Testing
tree.description: Master network infrastructure penetration testing: port scanning, service enumeration, privilege escalation, and Active Directory domain takeover.

resources.title: The Hacker Playbook 3: Practical Guide To Penetration Testing

children.name: Infrastructure Reconnaissance & Information Gathering
children.description: Execute active and passive reconnaissance: DNS brute-forcing (Amass), certificate transparency logs, OSINT gathering (Shodan, Censys), and network topology mapping.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Network Scanning & Vulnerability Analysis
children.description: Master network scanning: high-speed port scanning with Masscan, service version and OS fingerprinting with Nmap, writing custom Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE) scripts, and vulnerability scanning with Nessus.

children.name: Service Enumeration, Weaknesses & Exploitation
children.description: Enumerate and exploit network services: SMB (null sessions, EternalBlue), SNMP walk enumeration, NFS share mounting, misconfigured SSH keys, and unauthenticated database listeners.

resources.title: HackTricks Knowledge Base - Network Services Pentesting
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Exploitation Frameworks & Techniques
children.description: Master exploitation tools: Metasploit Framework (auxiliary scanners, multi-handler, Meterpreter payloads, staging), manual exploit modification, and compiling public exploits safely.

children.name: Linux Privilege Escalation
children.description: Master Linux privilege escalation: abusing SUID binaries with GTFOBins, misconfigured `sudo` rules without password requirements, exploiting writable cron jobs, Linux capabilities (`cap_setuid`), and kernel exploits.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Windows Privilege Escalation
children.description: Master Windows privilege escalation: Potato family token impersonation (JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer), unquoted service paths, insecure service permissions, DLL hijacking, and AlwaysInstallElevated registry abuse.

children.name: Active Directory Penetration Testing
children.description: Master Active Directory domain exploitation: domain reconnaissance with BloodHound/SharpHound, Kerberoasting service accounts, AS-REP Roasting, Pass-the-Hash (PtH) and Pass-the-Ticket (PtT), Golden/Silver Tickets, and DCSync domain controller credential harvesting.

resources.title: Hack The Box - Active Directory Module
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Post-Exploitation, Persistence & Lateral Movement
children.description: Execute post-exploitation and lateral movement: pivoting through internal subnets with Chisel and SSH dynamic port forwarding, harvesting memory credentials with Mimikatz, and establishing stealthy persistence mechanisms.

children.name: Wireless Network Penetration Testing
children.description: Audit wireless network security: WPA2 4-way handshake capture and cracking (Aircrack-ng, Hashcat), Rogue Access Points (Evil Twin), and enterprise 802.1X network testing.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Cloud Security Assessment Fundamentals (AWS, Azure, GCP)
children.description: Assess cloud environments: discovering exposed S3 buckets, exploiting compromised IAM credentials, and escalating privileges across cloud resources.

tree.name: Advanced Topics & Professional Practice
tree.description: Master professional penetration testing operations: reporting, red team adversary simulations, and mobile app assessments.

resources.title: Penetration Testing: A Hands-On Introduction to Hacking
Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Professional Reporting & Client Communication
children.description: Author client-ready penetration testing reports: executive summaries for C-level leadership, detailed technical vulnerability breakdowns, step-by-step reproduction steps with sanitized screenshots, CVSS v3.1 scoring, and actionable remediation engineering guidance.

children.name: Social Engineering Techniques
children.description: Understand social engineering assessments: spear-phishing simulation frameworks (GoPhish), credential harvesting portals, and physical security walkthrough methodologies.

resources.title: Social Engineering: The Art of Human Hacking (Chris Hadnagy)
Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)

children.name: Red Teaming & Adversary Simulation Concepts
children.description: Transition from penetration testing to Red Teaming: simulating real-world Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), adversary emulation plans, and testing Blue Team detection capabilities.

resources.title: Red Team Operations: A Practical Guide
Intro to Red Teaming (Hack The Box Academy)

children.name: Mobile Application Penetration Testing (Android & iOS)
children.description: Penetration test mobile applications: dynamic analysis using Frida for SSL pinning bypass, static decompilation with Jadx and APKTool, and inspecting insecure local storage.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Full Course (The Cyber Mentor)

children.name: Career Development & Certifications
children.description: Prepare for industry offensive security certifications: Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO), or eLearnSecurity Junior Penetration Tester (eJPT); and master technical pentest interviews.

children.name: Capstone Project: Full-Scope Penetration Test Simulation
children.description: Capstone Project: Execute an End-to-End Enterprise Penetration Test: external perimeter reconnaissance, web application exploitation (SSRF to RCE), internal network pivoting via Chisel, Active Directory domain takeover via Kerberoasting and DCSync, and authoring a comprehensive professional remediation report.

resources.title: Cyber Defend Institute - Red Team Ops Lab
Ethical Hacking in 12 Hours - Full Course - Learn to Hack! (The Cyber Mentors)
